threat_event: A known vulnerability in an SYS-E1 remote access gateway is exploited to reach customer networks and the Carrier management plane
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Internet-facing gateways; patching outside the 14-day target in 2026; persistent tunnels
likelihood_basis: EV-054 (internet-facing gateways; 2026 patches outside the 14-day target; persistent tunnels); EV-011 (14-day target)
existing_controls: EDR on gateway hosts; vendor advisories
treatment_plan: Patch within 72 hours for known exploited flaws; replace persistent tunnels with on-demand brokered sessions

threat_event: Shared gateway administrator accounts are stolen or misused
likelihood_basis: EV-054 (6 shared administrator accounts in the PAM vault)
existing_controls: Accounts stored in the PAM vault
treatment_plan: Named accounts through PAM with session recording

vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Gateway and collector logs not in the SIEM
likelihood_basis: EV-008 (gateway and collector logs not in the SIEM); EV-054 (30-day local logs)

threat_event: Customer outage or incident notices miss contract deadlines (30 minutes; 24 or 72 hours)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Notices are manual; not in the group IR plan
likelihood_basis: EV-055 (notices sent by email; no register); EV-053 (30-minute, 24-hour and 72-hour terms); EV-021 (not in the group IR plan)
treatment_plan: Notice register by customer; automated outage notices; include in P08 matrix

threat_event: Engineering operators misuse Carrier or customer subscriber data in tickets
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Legacy cross-tenant role; customer tickets include subscriber names and addresses
likelihood_basis: EV-040 (legacy cross-tenant role); EV-053 (tickets with subscriber names and addresses)
treatment_plan: Role removal (GR-02); CPNI and customer data training

threat_event: Covered equipment is shipped to a federal project or the Carrier and not reported within 1 business day
likelihood_basis: EV-029 (manual screening without records); EV-056 (12 federal contracts with 52.204-25)

threat_event: Federal contract information leaves the enclave or media is not sanitized
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two project offices lack disposal records and visitor logs
likelihood_basis: EV-058 (visitor logs and disposal certificates provided for 4 of 6 offices); EV-057 (enclave copy controls)
treatment_plan: Disposal and visitor procedures at all project offices

threat_event: Ransomware halts design and project systems
likelihood_basis: EV-016 (shared identity and hub); EV-019 (immutable backups); EV-010 (EDR)
treatment_plan: Restore test of SYS-E2 each quarter

threat_event: An MNO operator's remote change causes a customer outage
treatment_plan: One change procedure with peer review for all customers

threat_event: Hurricane overloads crews and the MNO center
likelihood_basis: EV-055 (storm plan shared with construction crews); EV-070 (crew sharing during storms)

threat_event: Customers leave because no SOC 2 report is available by 2027
likelihood_basis: EV-053 (37 customers require a SOC 2 Type 2 report by the end of 2027)
treatment_plan: P09 readiness plan; Type 1 as of 2027-03-31; Type 2 report issued by 2027-11-30

threat_event: Generative design assistant produces flawed designs or leaks customer designs
likelihood_basis: EV-031 (design assistant pilot with 120 designers); EV-070 (design assistant accounts)
existing_controls: Professional engineer review of every design

threat_event: Subcontracted crews misuse customer site access or designs
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Engineering security and compliance lead

threat_event: AI alarm triage suppresses a reportable outage alarm
likelihood_basis: EV-031 (alarm triage in production); EV-070 (alarm flood handling)
existing_controls: Operators see suppressed alarms in a queue
treatment_plan: Never auto-close alarms tagged 911 or special facility; weekly sample review
